prompts.images.subject.detailed: [subject] [action] in [setting], [time of day], [weather]. Main subject in the centre, background not distracting. Style: [style]. No text or logos.
prompts.images.subject.refine: Same image, but with [subject] closer to the viewer and a simpler background.
prompts.images.subject.check: Here's my image description: [description]. What details are missing for a predictable result?
prompts.images.style.detailed: [subject], [style: watercolour / flat vector illustration / photograph / 3D / pencil sketch], [technique: soft strokes / clean outlines / grain], limited palette of [number] colours, consistent style across the whole image.
prompts.images.style.refine: Same scene in [another style]. Keep the composition.
prompts.images.style.check: Describe 4 styles that suit [purpose] and how they differ in mood.
prompts.images.angle.detailed: [subject] in [setting], angle: [top-down / low / eye level / side], shot: [close-up / medium / wide], subject fills [share] of the frame, horizon line [high / low].
prompts.images.angle.refine: Make the same shot from below so [subject] looks more significant.
prompts.images.angle.check: Which angle best conveys [mood] for [subject] and why?
prompts.images.light.detailed: [subject] in [setting], lighting: [soft diffused / backlight / warm evening / cool morning], light from the [left / right / top], soft shadows, no blown-out highlights.
prompts.images.light.refine: Make the light more dramatic: more contrast, light from the side.
prompts.images.light.check: What lighting suits [mood] and how do I describe it to a generator?
prompts.images.palette.detailed: [subject], limited palette: main colour [colour 1], secondary [colour 2], accent [colour 3], muted tones, plenty of empty space for a headline [at the top / on the left].
prompts.images.palette.refine: Make the palette warmer but keep the accent colour.
prompts.images.palette.check: Suggest 3 palettes for [topic] and explain the mood each creates.
prompts.images.series.short: A series of [number] images: [topic], consistent style
prompts.images.series.detailed: Shared part for every image in the series: style [style], palette [colours], lighting [lighting], format [aspect ratio]. Only the scene changes: 1) [scene 1]; 2) [scene 2]; 3) [scene 3]. Copy the shared part unchanged into each prompt.
prompts.images.series.refine: Image [number] doesn't match the series. Redo it with a stronger shared description.
prompts.images.series.check: Here's my shared description: [description]. What should I add to make the series more consistent?
prompts.images.background.short: Background for [purpose]: [topic], calm, no detail in the centre
prompts.images.background.detailed: Abstract background for [purpose: slide / cover / banner], theme [topic], [colours], smooth shapes at the edges, empty uniform centre for text, no lettering, format [aspect ratio].
prompts.images.background.refine: Make the background lighter so dark text reads well.
prompts.images.background.check: Will a background with [description] work for [colour] text? How can I check the contrast?
prompts.images.school.short: Illustration for a project about [topic] for [age]
prompts.images.school.detailed: A clear illustration for a school project about [topic] for [age]. Show: [what to show]. Simple shapes, calm colours, no small details or lettering (I'll add labels myself), scientifically plausible.
prompts.images.school.refine: Simplify the image: keep only [key elements].
prompts.images.school.check: What factual errors are common in illustrations of [topic]?
prompts.images.diagram.short: Describe the structure of a “[topic]” diagram: blocks and links
prompts.images.diagram.detailed: A clean infographic-style diagram: [number] blocks linked by arrows left to right, a flat icon in each block, white background, [colours], no text inside (I'll add labels in an editor).
prompts.images.diagram.refine: Reduce the diagram to 5 key blocks and explain what you merged.
prompts.images.diagram.check: Here's my diagram in words: [diagram]. Are there mistakes in the order or links?
prompts.images.exclude.detailed: [subject] [action] in [setting], [style] style. The image must not contain: text or lettering, logos, watermarks, recognisable real people, [what else to exclude].
prompts.images.exclude.refine: [unwanted element] still appeared. Describe the scene so there's no room for it.
prompts.images.exclude.check: What in my description might have caused [unwanted element]? [description]

verify.images.subject: Look at the details: extra fingers, garbled text, odd shadows. If something's off, refine the description instead of repeating it.
verify.images.style: Avoid living artists' names and recognisable styles for commercial work: check the service's terms.
verify.images.angle: Compare a few angles side by side and choose the one where the main subject reads instantly.
verify.images.light: Check that the lighting matches the time of day and weather in your description.
verify.images.palette: If the image goes into slides or a website, check that text stays readable on top of it.
verify.images.series: Put the series side by side: are the style, palette and proportions consistent?
verify.images.background: Test the background under real text: the contrast must be enough to read.
verify.images.school: Mark in your work that the illustration was made with AI if the rules require it. Check for factual errors.
verify.images.diagram: Image generators often get labels and arrows wrong. For an accurate diagram it's safer to draw it in an editor or ask a text assistant for its structure.
verify.images.exclude: Not every generator understands negatives in the text. If yours has a separate field for exclusions, move the second part there.
